definitions: A structure made of strips of wood or metal crossed and fastened together with square or diamond-shaped spaces in between.
A regular arrangement of points or objects over an area or in space.
A mathematical structure consisting of a partially ordered set in which every pair of elements has a unique greatest lower bound and a unique least upper bound.
examples: A lattice of vines covered the pergola.
The crystal has a cubic lattice structure.
In abstract algebra, a Boolean algebra is a complemented distributive lattice.
